subject: hoverPickup
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: militarized pickup converted to hover thrusters.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk.

spec.name: Hoverhauler MK-IV
spec.description: A militarized pickup truck converted to ride on four glowing hover thrusters, in low-poly cyberpunk style with neon trim, armor plates and a roof-mounted gun.
spec.layout: A chunky pickup silhouette hovering about 0.35 m off the floor on four vertical thrusters at the wheel positions, which hang just below the chassis. The cab sits at the front-middle with a sloped windshield, and the open cargo bed is at the back with a roll bar, a rear light bar and ammo crates. The hood is at the front (+Z) with a neon grille. The hull is armored dark gunmetal with yellow hazard trim, cyan and magenta neon strips, and angular faceted plates throughout. The thrusters are the floor-touching parts: their lowest rims sit at y=0.02. Neon cyan glows from the thruster cores, headlights, underglow strips and screens. Magenta marks the rear lights and decals. All shapes are blocky, angular and low-poly with panelled paints, hazard-stripe textures and SVG decals.

parts.builds: The lower hull: a faceted armored chassis slab and skirt panels with panelled gunmetal paint and rivets, hazard-yellow trim stripes along the sides, front armored bumper with a plough wedge and neon cyan grille bars, headlight clusters, a rear bumper with tow hooks, wheel-arch style thruster bays (dark recesses where the thrusters mount), underglow neon strips under the sill, and an under-belly plate with vents. Includes the hood with scoop and armor louvres, fender plates, and side-mounted exhaust or capacitor pipes.
parts.attaches: Sits on the body joint. The cab starts at the cabFloor and chassisTop mounts. The bed starts at bedFloor. The thruster bays surround the four thruster mounts.

parts.builds: The armored crew cab: angular boxy cabin with sloped windshield and side windows in tinted glass with cyan HUD-style reflection decals, thick armor plating on the doors with panelled paint and hazard numbering decals, door handles, side mirrors with small screens, a roof with antenna array, roof light bar with magenta and cyan lights, a snorkel intake on the A-pillar, a sun-visor armor flap over the windshield, a cyberpunk SVG emblem on the door (a skull-and-circuit logo), and a glimpsed interior with seats and a neon dashboard.
parts.attaches: Sits on the chassis at the cabFloor mount. The roofTop mount carries the antenna and light bar, and the bed's front wall is flush with the cab's back at z=-0.55.

parts.builds: The open cargo bed: floor, side walls with armor ribbing and hazard trim, a tailgate with neon magenta tail-light strips and an SVG decal, a rear light bar, a roll cage of rods behind the cab, ammo crates and a fuel drum strapped with straps, a hardpoint ring at gunRing with a ring-shaped rail and the gun mount base. The gun is a pintle-mounted minigun with a shield plate, barrel cluster, ammo belt and ammo box, built on the gunYaw and gunPitch joints, with a glowing cyan sight.
parts.attaches: Starts at the bedFloor mount on the chassis top (y=1.0) and meets the cab at z=-0.55. The gun rides gunYaw and gunPitch at the gunRing mount.

parts.builds: Four hover thruster units, one at each thruster mount. Each has a mounting strut and an armored housing in dark metal, a lathe-turned downward-flaring nozzle with ribbed rings, a glowing cyan core disc and a magenta ring accent, hazard-yellow bands, small stabiliser fins, cable bundles up to the chassis, and a soft glow cone or card layer of cyan beneath. The nozzle lowest rim sits at y=0.02, so these touch the floor line. Each unit rides its own thruster joint.
parts.attaches: Each unit is centred on its thrusterXX mount (x ±1.05, z ±1.75) and joins the chassis thruster bay above at y=0.7. It rides the matching joint.
